ILLUSTRATIVE WORKFLOW
BILLING & COLLECTIONS

A clearer view of every taka.

Understand the planned flow from test order and invoice to payment, outstanding dues, and daily closing.

01

Orders & invoices

Create a bill from selected tests and panels; authorized discounts require a reason.

02

Payments & dues

Record full or partial payments and follow outstanding balances. Cash, bKash, and card payments are recorded manually.

03

Refunds & corrections

Keep original payment records and document linked reversals, refunds, and their reasons.

04

Daily cash closing

Review collections by user and payment method, cash refunds, expected cash, counted cash, and variance.

✳

Sales and collections are different measures. Manual bKash and card records do not verify a payment through a gateway.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE

One invoice, two payments.

A patient pays part today and the rest later. Each collection belongs to the day it was received.
